name: Rimmlhof
beschreibung:
History

The Rimmlhof presents itself on rimmlstube.at as a farm holiday in Rinnen near Berwang, run by the Rimml family; in the imprint of the farm page, Franziska Rimml. A founding year of the farm is not given on the pages mentioned. What is published is what the farm is today: rooms and holiday apartments in the mountain landscape of the Lechtaler Alpen, within the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena, plus the Rimmlstube. The rooms bear farm and field names. Room 4 is called „Von Bäurinnen & Bauern“ and is described as a piece of farm history; room 5 „Raazalm“ refers to an alpine pasture around Berwang; room 6 „Rotlechtal“ to a side valley. Apartment 1, the Fichtenstube, advertises spruce wood from its own forest. Older directories list for the same name in some cases the address Rinnen 45 and the telephone number +43 5674 20144. The current farm page names Rinnen 6, 6622 Berwang, telephone +43 5674 20820 and info@rimmlstube.at. The farm page assigns the place to the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena and the Lechtaler Alpen, not to the Tannheimer Tal.

Getting there

The published address is Franziska Rimml, Rinnen 6, 6622 Berwang. A separate timetable page with bus line numbers is not present on the farm pages retrieved. For rooms the price list asks guests to report on arrival on +43 5674 208220. On the apartment price list the number given for arrival is +43 5674 20820. Both numbers stand as such on the respective pages and are not merged here into a single one. Check-in is from 16:00 or by arrangement, check-out until 9:00 or by arrangement. Payment is in cash or by bank transfer in advance.

Tips

The page advertises brown mountain sheep and other farm animals, which in summer stand on the pastures or on the alpine pasture and in winter in the stable. As stays it names family holidays, hiking, cycling and mountain biking, a motorcycle tour, winter sports and days for two. In the Rimmlstube many specialities come, according to the farm, directly from its own farm, plus game from its own and local hunting. A four-course evening menu costs 33 euros per person per day, on request also for people with allergies and for vegetarians. Rooms 4, 5 and 6 have their own bathroom with shower and WC. The sizes: room 4 about 25 square metres for 2 to 3 people, room 5 about 25 square metres for 2 people, room 6 about 30 square metres for 2 people. Apartment 1 Fichtenstube measures about 45 square metres for 2 to 4 people, apartment 101 about 50 square metres for 2 to 4 people, apartment 102 about 65 square metres for 4 people, maximum 5. Apartments 101 and 102 are in the Rimmlstube, apartment 102 with two separate bedrooms.

Summer prices of the rooms without breakfast, excluding local tax: rooms 4 and 5 from 49 euros, room 6 from 50 euros per adult per day. In winter the same rooms are from 55 and 60 euros respectively. The local tax is 3 euros per person per day, a dog 15 euros per day. For one night a short-stay surcharge of 5 euros per person is added. Apartment summer prices start at apartment 1 from 98 euros for 2 people, apartment 101 from 120 euros for 2 people and apartment 102 from 150 euros for 2 people, in each case per apartment per day. Final cleaning of the apartments costs 60 euros. Breakfast is not included in these room prices. A child discount and a single-room surcharge are available on request.
kurzbeschreibung: Farm holiday of the Rimml family in Rinnen near Berwang, with rooms, holiday apartments and a stop at the Rimmlstube, in the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena.
